notes: BAR military unit taxonomy. Two orthogonal axes: TECH tier (1/2/3 -> color) and CLASS/role (-> symbol). Bump `version` on ANY change to classes/seeds/heuristics; the analysis DB records the version used per game so games can be re-analyzed and overwritten when this improves. See process/lib/unitType.mjs (classifier) and process/lib/analysisDb.mjs (version-aware store).

spam.label: Spam
spam.desc: very cheap mass units, traded freely (Tick, Rover)

raider.label: Raider
raider.desc: fast cheap harassers that punish eco

main.label: Main line
main.desc: core standing-army combat (Pawn, Rocketeer, Stout, Janus)

brawler.label: Brawler
brawler.desc: direct-fire assault, high HP, short range (Centurion, Mace)

_seed_note: defName -> {class, tech?}. Anchors the classifier for units where heuristics are weak. Internal names verified against a live All-That-Glitters stream (2026-06-12).
_heuristics_note: Fallback when a def is not seeded. Uses fields the widget/gex emit on the unit def. Cost-only data (slim live unit_def) degrades gracefully to spam/main by cost.
